verificationSummary: Editor commit 623d91f204803cb9ac8d7ab7a71246326b77ef78 updates the Backend capability parser to recognize columns.insert and text-block.insert in active mutation operation lists. The compatibility check remains rollout-safe: active Backend support still requires node delete, duplicate, and reorder, so the live compatibility harness remains compatible with the previous Backend package while the new Backend can advertise add-node support. The test fixture now covers an active capability response containing columns.insert and text-block.insert. RED evidence: npm test -- --run src/tests/versionCapability.test.ts failed before parser implementation because the updated active operation list produced invalid-response. GREEN evidence: npm test -- --run src/tests/versionCapability.test.ts passed 1 file and 7 tests. Editor worktree npm run check and merged Editor main npm run check both passed type-check, Vitest with 96 passed test files and 332 tests, and build. Vite retained the existing chunk-size warning, and Editor npm install reported 5 high severity audit findings; neither was remediated in this lane. This evidence does not widen BackendMutationOperation request creation, does not call commitMutation for add-node, does not enable visible add-node UI, WYSIWYG behavior, contenteditable runtime, active text input, durable draft persistence, document v4 insert semantics, production Backend readiness, deployed compatibility, broad frontend readiness, Editor truth, Backend truth, Core truth, FlowDoc product truth, or map truth. After merge, branch editor-add-node-capability-20260830 was deleted and Git worktree metadata for C:/Users/nekot/Documents/GitHub/fd-ed-anc-cap-0830 was removed, but the folder remains on disk after git worktree remove failed with Filename too long. The older C:/Users/nekot/Documents/GitHub/fd-ed-ati-0830 worktree remains intentionally retained detached at d2290b47a37adc8aee2067ed4e094c6f39350b6c because node_modules contains junctions to Core and cleanup still needs a safer dependency-link plan.
